subject.title: Control UI: preview GitHub issues and pull requests on hover

question: Should the Gateway-owned public GitHub issue/PR preview fetcher proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100434 be accepted as the core Control UI solution for this feature?
rationale: The request adds new user-facing Control UI behavior plus Gateway network/API surface that may use ambient host GitHub credentials, so maintainer intent is needed before treating the direction as accepted.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the Gateway-mediated preview design if the public-only fetch boundary and merge conflicts are resolved.

options.title: Request a narrower preview boundary
options.body: Keep the feature open but require a smaller method shape, no ambient-token use, or stronger tests before accepting the core surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep ordinary link navigation for now and close or pause the linked PR if maintainers do not want this in core.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the Gateway-mediated preview design if the public-only fetch boundary and merge conflicts are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the issue and candidate implementation path in the live GitHub thread.
